# Signing Market — How It Works

The Signing Market is how you build your squad. It stays **open for the whole mid-season** — no rounds, no admin timers. Every unclaimed player is a free agent, and each offer plays out on its own clock: sign instantly when nobody else wants the player, or trigger a short **decision window** when rivals do. The market closes automatically when the season moves into the finale or retention stage.

## The Flow

1. Browse the market — start from your personalized **Recommended** picks
2. Send an offer — the amount is **reserved** from your balance
3. No real competition → the player decides **instantly**
4. Rivals want them too → a sealed **decision window** opens (5–20 minutes)
5. When the window ends, the player picks a team
6. Won signings **join your squad automatically** — no claiming needed

## Finding Players

### Recommended (default view)
With no filters applied, the Market tab shows ~20 players picked for **your team**: they fill your XI gaps, respect your quota, and cover every position. Tap **Shuffle** for a fresh mix, or **Browse all** for the full grid.

### Search & Filters
Search by name, or open the filter modal for role, batting order & style, bowling type, style keywords, OVR range, pools, nationality, legends, and your **watchlist**. The **Open / All** switch hides players your quota can't fit (Open is the default). Applied filters show as pills — tap a pill to remove it.

### Header Tools
- **Shield icon** — your pool quotas (A–E) at a glance
- **XI icon** — your **Potential Playing XI** (see below)
- **Info icon** — this guide

## Potential Playing XI

Tap the **XI** icon to see the best XI you could field right now from three sources combined: your squad, players you have **offers** on, and **signed** players awaiting a squad slot. Cards are tagged OFFER or SIGNED when they aren't on your roster yet. **Empty slots mean you cannot field 11 in that formation — those are the positions to buy.** Scout suggestions at the bottom tell you what to fix first.

## Scout Tab

The Scout analyses your squad (offers included) against 12 tactical balance rules and ranks what to do:

- **Missing** (critical) — archetypes you don't have, and any players needed just to **complete your XI**
- **Upgrade** — a clearly better, affordable, quota-legal free agent exists at a position you own
- **Light cover** — one injury away from a hole

Tap **View targets** on any card to jump to matching players in the market.

## Sending an Offer

Tap a player and check the Signing tab before committing:

### Interest Preview
Four gauges show how interested the player is in **your team**: **Squad Need**, **Playing Time**, **Price**, and **Prestige**. They update live as you change the price. The scout line below gives the XI verdict in one sentence.

### Setting Your Price
- Offers start at the **base price** — going below is rejected
- The amount is **reserved** from your balance when you send; it comes back if you withdraw, lose, or the signing expires unclaimed
- Higher offers help, with diminishing returns — 1× to 1.5× base makes a real difference; 3× to 5× barely moves the needle. **Squad fit beats money.**
- Lowball offers below the player's **rejection floor** are declined instantly

## Decision Windows

When you offer on a player, the market measures **real competition** — which other teams need this player, can afford them, and have quota room.

- **No competition** → the player decides **instantly**
- **Competition** → a decision window opens: **5–20 minutes**, longer the hotter the race. The heat badge (low → fierce) tells you how contested it is.
- **Sealed bids** — you see the rival offer count, deadline, and heat. Never their amounts.
- **Anti-snipe** — any offer or price change in the final 2 minutes extends the deadline a little (hard-capped), so last-second sniping doesn't work
- **Modify or withdraw** any time while the window is open. Withdrawing the only offer collapses the window.
- Watchlisted players notify you the moment a rival opens a window on them

## How Players Decide

It is **not highest-bidder-wins**. Players weigh squad need, playing time, offer price, and team prestige, then all valid offers enter a **weighted draw** — the best-fitting team has the best chance, but a close second can still win. The best-managed squad wins over time, not the richest one. If every offer is below the player's floor, they reject everyone and stay on the market.

## Decisions & Results

You get a notification for every decision:

- **Signed** — the player accepted and **joined your squad automatically**. If your squad was full, the notification says so — free a slot, then add them from **History**.
- **Outbid** — another team won. Your reserved amount returns instantly. The winning amount stays sealed.
- **Declined** — nobody met the floor; the player stays available.

## Squad Delivery & the History Tab

Signed players are added to your squad **automatically** — there is nothing to claim. The **History** tab is your full offer ledger: every offer you ever sent, latest first, each with its state — **Pending**, **In Team**, **Released** or **Missed**. Filter it like the market (roles, keywords, OVR, nationality, offer status) and tap any row for that offer's full story.

The only exception is a **full squad (25)**: the signing waits in an amber **Ready to Add** card pinned to the top of History for **72 hours**.

- **Make room first** — sell or release a player from your squad
- **Add** — delivers the waiting signing once a slot is free
- **Replace** — pick who to release; your squad is sorted by similarity to the incoming player, most redundant first
- Unclaimed signings expire back to the market after 72 hours (with a refund)

You can keep offering even at 25 players — the cap only applies to delivery.

## Pool Quotas

Players are split into **5 OVR pools** (**A** highest → **E** lowest) and every team has a per-pool quota:

- Your pool count = **roster + active offers** — you can't stack offers you couldn't fit
- Remainder slots go to **higher-ranked teams first**
- Offers that would breach a quota are blocked up front — the **Open** view and the quota-aware recommendations already hide those players

## Tips

1. **Start from Recommended.** It already accounts for your gaps, quota, and budget.
2. **Check the XI icon before spending.** Empty slots are your real shopping list — complete the XI before chasing upgrades.
3. **Trust the interest gauges.** Low Need + low Time means the player probably won't come at any price.
4. **Read the heat.** Low heat = don't overpay; fierce heat = decide fast whether they're worth a bidding fight you can't see.
5. **Don't try to snipe.** Late offers extend the window.
6. **Don't ignore the amber card.** A signing stuck on a full squad expires after 72h — the reserved coins stay locked until you add them or it lapses.
